author: Adam Uren
title: Heavy snow snarls Twin Cities commute; no travel advisories in southern Minnesota - NewsBreak
text:
By Adam Uren ,
8 hours ago Heavy snow and blizzard conditions have contributed to horrendous conditions on Minnesota roads Wednesday afternoon and evening.
The Minnesota Department of Transportation has issued "no travel" advisories in south-central Minnesota, stretching from Granite Falls to southeast of Mankato , to as far northeast as Hutchinson, where heavy snow and high winds are creating blizzard conditions.
MN 511 A no travel advisory is also in effect along I-35 south of Cloquet to Proctor, just outside Duluth , due to whiteout conditions.
The snow turned heavy in the Twin Cities just in time for the evening commute, with traffic already slowing up on major metro area highways and residential streets.
MN 511 The Minnesota State Patrol is dealing with numerous crashes across the state, including a jackknifed semi-trailer on I-35 south of Faribault .
MnDOT is also reporting "numerous crashes" on U.S. Highway 14 in Kasson in southeastern Minnesota, prompting the road's closure as of 4:30 p.m.
MN 511 The State Patrol says there had been 60 crashes with damage ‚Äì including 5 with injuries ‚Äì and 113 vehicles off the road across the state as of noon.
That number is expected to rise considerably by the end of the day.
Models on Wednesday afternoon showed that snow was expected to continue in the Twin Cities through 8 p.m., with several inches of accumulation expected by then.
